Write a bibliography of reports from their own CITATION.cff records

Source: R/xct_cff.R
xct_bib_from_cff.Rd

A report that cites another report can cite it by that report's own CITATION.cff, the one record its citations come from, rather than by a reference-manager entry typed from it. Each repository's record is read from its default branch on GitHub, converted with cffr::as_bibentry() using what = "preferred" (a @TechReport naming the publisher as institution), and keyed by the repository name, so a report is cited as [@<repo>].

Usage

xct_bib_from_cff(repos, path, owner = "NewGraphEnvironment")

Arguments

repos

character Repository names to cite. An empty vector writes an empty file.

path

character Path of the .bib file to write.

owner

character The GitHub owner of the repositories.

Value

path, invisibly.

Details

Any record that cannot be read, does not validate, or gives no report entry with a title and authors stops the call: a bibliography that silently drops an entry would render that citation unresolved with nothing to say why. The file is written atomically.

The repositories must be public: no token is sent.

See also

Other cff: xct_cff_refresh()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
xct_bib_from_cff(
  c("fish_passage_peace_2024_reporting", "fish_passage_skeena_2024_reporting"),
  path = file.path(tempdir(), "references-reports.bib")
)
} # }
